```{r}
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
## Project: Monthly Airbnb Demand Forecasting - Chicago
## Instructor: Dr. Jabir Rahman
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##

library(fpp3)
library(readr)

# 1. LOAD DATA
path_to_data <- "D:/OKCU Study Materials/forecasting/final project/reviews.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(path_to_data)

# 2. DATA PREPARATION & MONTHLY AGGREGATION
# We aggregate the 'count' from the raw data into monthly buckets
library(lubridate)

# Convert FIRST
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

# Now this works
last_date <- max(raw_data$date, na.rm = TRUE)

last_complete_month <- yearmonth(
  floor_date(last_date, "month") - days(1)
)

airbnb <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date)) %>%
  count(month, name = "count") %>%
  filter(month <= last_complete_month) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = month) %>%
  mutate(log_count = log1p(count))

# 3. EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS (Shortened to post-2022 for stability)
airbnb_short <- airbnb %>% filter(year(month) > 2022)

# Visualization of Trend and Seasonality
airbnb_short %>% autoplot(log_count) + 
  labs(title = "Monthly Airbnb Log-Demand (Chicago)", y = "Log(Count)")

# STL Decomposition
airbnb_short %>%
  model(stl = STL(log_count)) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot()

# 4. TRAIN/TEST SPLIT
# Hold out the last 6 months for testing
h_horizon <- 6
train <- airbnb_short %>% slice(1:(n() - h_horizon))
test  <- airbnb_short %>% slice_tail(n = h_horizon)

# 5. BUILD BASELINE MODELS
fit_base <- train %>%
  model(
    Mean = MEAN(log_count),
    `Naïve` = NAIVE(log_count),
    `Seasonal Naïve` = SNAIVE(log_count),
    Drift = RW(log_count ~ drift()),
    ETS = ETS(log_count),
    ARIMA = ARIMA(log_count)
  )

# 6. FORECASTING
fc_base <- fit_base %>% forecast(h = h_horizon)

# 7. COMPARE ACCURACY
# Compare forecasts against the actual 'test' data
accuracy_table <- fc_base %>% 
  accuracy(airbnb_short) %>%
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE) %>%
  arrange(RMSE)

print("--- Model Accuracy Comparison ---")
print(accuracy_table)

# 8. FINAL VISUALIZATION
fc_base %>%
  autoplot(airbnb_short, level = NULL) +
  labs(
    y = "Log(Count)",
    title = "Comparison of Baseline Forecasts vs Actuals",
    subtitle = "Chicago Monthly Airbnb Reviews"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Step A: Determine differencing (d)
train |> features(log_count, unitroot_ndiffs)

# Step B: Visualize ACF/PACF of the differenced data
train |> 
  gg_tsdisplay(difference(log_count), plot_type = 'partial') +
  labs(title = "Differenced Log-Demand ACF/PACF")
```


```{r}
# Step A: Determine seasonal differencing (D)
train |> features(log_count, unitroot_nsdiffs)

# Step B: Fit a manual SARIMA model 
# Let's assume a seasonal AR(1) component based on the monthly frequency
fit_sarima <- train |>
  model(
    #manual_sarima = ARIMA(log_count ~ pdq(1,1,0) + PDQ(1,0,0)),
    auto_sarima = ARIMA(log_count)
  )

report(fit_sarima |> select(auto_sarima))
```


```{r}
# Check residuals for the automated ARIMA model
fit_sarima |> 
  select(auto_sarima) |> 
  gg_tsresiduals()

# Ljung-Box test to confirm no remaining autocorrelation
augment(fit_sarima) |>
  filter(.model == "auto_sarima") |>
  features(.innov, ljung_box, lag = 12, dof = 3)
```


```{r}
# Combine models for a final showdown
fit_final <- train |>
  model(
    # Aligning with your tests: d=1, D=1
    Manual_SARIMA = ARIMA(log_count ~ pdq(1,1,0) + PDQ(0,1,1)),
    Auto_ARIMA = ARIMA(log_count)
  )

fit_final |> select(Manual_SARIMA) |> report()

# Forecast and calculate accuracy on test set
fc_final <- fit_final |> forecast(h = h_horizon)

accuracy_final <- fc_final |> 
  accuracy(airbnb_short) |>
  arrange(RMSE)

print("--- Final Model Comparison (Baseline vs ARIMA vs SARIMA) ---")
accuracy_final |> select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)
```


```{r}
#Advanced Forecasting Models
#A.
#STL + ETS Model
stl_ets_model <- train %>%
  model(
    STL_ETS = decomposition_model(
      STL(log_count ~ season(window = "periodic")),
      ETS(season_adjust ~ season("N"))
    )
  )

# Forecast
fc_stl_ets <- stl_ets_model %>%
  forecast(h = h_horizon)

# Plot
fc_stl_ets %>%
  autoplot(airbnb_short) +
  labs(title = "STL + ETS Forecast")
```
```{r}
# Neural Network Model
fit_nn <- train %>%
  model(
    NNETAR(log_count)
  )

fc_nn <- fit_nn %>%
  forecast(h = h_horizon)

fc_nn %>%
  autoplot(airbnb_short) +
  labs(title = "Neural Network Forecast")
```

```{r}
# Combine all models
fit_all <- train %>%
  model(
    ARIMA = ARIMA(log_count),
    ETS = ETS(log_count),
    STL_ETS = decomposition_model(
      STL(log_count ~ season(window = "periodic")),
      ETS(season_adjust ~ season("N"))
    ),
    NN = NNETAR(log_count)
  )

fc_all <- fit_all %>%
  forecast(h = h_horizon)

# Accuracy comparison
accuracy(fc_all, airbnb_short)
```

```{r}
# Combine models
fit_combined <- train %>%
  model(
    ARIMA = ARIMA(log_count),
    ETS = ETS(log_count),
    STL_ETS = decomposition_model(
      STL(log_count ~ season(window = "periodic")),
      ETS(season_adjust ~ season("N"))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(Combo = (ARIMA + ETS + STL_ETS) / 3)

# Forecast
fc_combo <- fit_combined %>%
  forecast(h = h_horizon)

# Accuracy
accuracy(fc_combo, airbnb_short)
```

```{r}
# Re-fit to the entire airbnb_short dataset
final_production_fit <- airbnb_short |>
  model(Best_Model = ARIMA(log_count))

# Forecast 12 months into the future
final_production_fit |>
  forecast(h = 12) |>
  autoplot(airbnb_short) +
  labs(
    title = "12-Month Airbnb Demand Forecast (Chicago)",
    subtitle = "Based on optimal ARIMA parameters",
    y = "Log(Count)"
  )
```
